name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: Breadth is the point here: Meta, Google and OpenAI custom silicon in one KeyBanc update. If Broadcom holds the inference-heavy SKUs, that's the part to watch. Broker note, not a company confirmation. $AVGO

If this holds, the constraint moves a step downstream. Packaging capacity, not just wafers, sets the pace for custom accelerators, and a 10-20% price move would hit exactly there. Still reported, not TSMC confirmed. $AVGO
Fair point, the VMware overhang explains a lot of the debt load. Whether that deleveraging keeps pace is the thing to watch, with the stock still sitting below its 20-, 50- and 200-day averages.
630 亿美元这笔 Anthropic 算力融资，结构比数字有意思：华尔街四家出钱，SPV 买博通的定制 XPU 和组网设备租给 Anthropic，2027 年起交付。招股书里博通是最大算力对手方，约 1610 亿美元。但 Anthropic 上半年还亏 807 亿，兑现节奏得盯着。$AVGO

The Azure qualification is the key bit here. First and only SMR drive on Broadcom's HBA approved list is a real hurdle cleared, not just a lab result. Still, revenue impact is unquantified, so the question is whether hyperscalers deploy it at scale. $AVGO

The supply side of this is what stands out. You don't lock in $126.8B of purchase commitments, almost all due in fiscal 2027 and 2028, unless the order book behind it is real. The question is how much of that $179B converts on schedule, not whether demand is there. $AVGO
刚看到一篇拆 800G 光模块的帖子，讲得挺明白：模块一头是电信号、一头是光，中间靠 DSP 把信号理干净，DSP 这块主要就是博通和 Marvell 在供。800G 是 8 条 100G 拼出来的，下一代 1.6T 换成 8 条 200G，1.6T 的放量节奏值得继续盯着。$AVGO

That $250B figure is eye-catching, but the harder part for Google is turning TPU demand into sustained share, not just a good quarter. For AVGO, the read-through is more about custom-chip execution than the headline number itself.

This second-order read matters more than the $CRDO move. If Cisco's 1.6T program really opens up to $AVGO or $MXL, that is a real interconnect opening. As the post says, nothing is confirmed yet, so this stays a rumor for now, not a design win.

The MSFT comparison is the interesting part here. Microsoft at its $360 lows felt just as heavy, and $AVGO sitting on $320 feels the same way right now. Sentiment can look worst right at support, which is not the same as the thesis breaking.

The $73B AI backlog is the part that stands out for Broadcom, especially with demand supply limited rather than demand limited. CoWoS and HBM still gate how fast it converts, so the financing squeeze you flag matters as much as the orders.
有帖子在算博通 AI 芯片这条线：从 580 亿到 2028 财年 2300 亿，两年差不多翻四倍。帖子里写的催化剂是 Anthropic 明年成最大 XPU 客户、OpenAI 那个 10GW 项目 2028 年爬坡。数字看着猛，兑现还得看客户量产节奏，12 月财报才是验算的时候。$AVGO
